news.title: Pornhub to become accessible again for some UK users
news.description: UK iPhone users who have completed Apple's device-based age checks will no longer be blocked from the site's adult content.

news.title: Oscars says AI actors and writing cannot win awards
news.description: The academy that controls the Oscars on Friday issued new award eligibility requirements around the use of artificial intelligence in film.

news.title: Pentagon says US military to be an 'AI-first' fighting force
news.description: The US military has agreed eight new contracts with big tech firms as it expands its artificial intelligence capabilities.

news.title: Google DeepMind Workers Vote to Unionize Over Military AI Deals
news.description: UK staff of Google’s AI research lab hope to block the use of the company’s artificial intelligence models in military settings.

news.title: He Couldn’t Land a Job Interview. Was AI to Blame?
news.description: Armed with some Python and a white-hot sense of injustice, one medical student spent six months trying to figure out whether an algorithm trashed his job application.

news.title: Greg Brockman Defends $30B OpenAI Stake: ‘Blood, Sweat, and Tears’
news.description: OpenAI’s cofounder and president revealed in federal court on Monday that he’s one of the largest individual stakeholders in the AI lab.

news.title: A Dark-Money Campaign Is Paying Influencers to Frame Chinese AI as a Threat
news.description: Build American AI, a nonprofit linked to a super PAC bankrolled by executives at OpenAI and Andreessen Horowitz, is funding a campaign to spread pro-AI messaging and stoke fears about China.

news.title: Why Reddit blocked my daily visit to its mobile website
news.description: Reddit REALLY wants you to use its app.
